info.title: sql-fun-server JSON-RPC api
info.description:
# `sql-fun` server api

`sql-fun` server provides database schema cache for `sql-fun` and schema aware
SQL semantics analysis.

schema.title: EchoArgs
schema.description: Object or array parameters returned unchanged by the diagnostic echo method.

methods.name: initialize_schema_context
methods.summary: load schema dump file for semantic analysis

schema.title: InitializeSchemaArgs
schema.description: Load schema dump and initialize semantic analysis context

engine_version.description: Used for loading builtin schema objects

expected_hash.description: Expected SHA-256 of the original dump text, supplied by the client.

environments.description: Explicit `SQL_FUN_HOME` and `SQL_FUN_METADATA_FILE`; other keys are rejected.

EngineDialect.description: Engine dialect selecting SQL syntax perser.

ContextHandle.description:
Opaque identifier for a connection's registered semantic analysis context.

Constructing a handle does not register a context or grant access. Handles
resolve only in the connection that issued them.

require_release.description: When true, client must be call `SqlFunServerApi::release_collection`

statement_span.description: Statement span, or None when not retained by analysis.

probrem_span.description: Problem span, or None when not retained by analysis.

statement_relative_span.description: Byte range relative to the SQL statement, when a file position is unavailable.

StatementByteRange.description: A retained byte range within a SQL statement, not a file position.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset from the SQL statement start.

length.description: Number of bytes in the retained range.

schema.title: ReadCollectionArgs
schema.description:
argument for [`crate::SqlFunServerApi::read_collection`]

The item type returned by `read_collection` is identical to the element type
of the original `Collection<T>` that produced the handle, and never changes.
This method only reads the continuation of that collection; no type conversion
is performed.

count.description:
read count

when None, client requests read to end, but server implementation has a hard limit
